app_user_has_name.name: app_user_has_name
app_user_has_name.value: "app_user"."name_en" IS NOT NULL OR "app_user"."name_bn" IS NOT NULL

branch_has_name.name: branch_has_name
branch_has_name.value: "branch"."name_en" IS NOT NULL OR "branch"."name_bn" IS NOT NULL

tenant_has_name.name: tenant_has_name
tenant_has_name.value: "tenant"."name_en" IS NOT NULL OR "tenant"."name_bn" IS NOT NULL

ledger_account_has_name.name: ledger_account_has_name
ledger_account_has_name.value: "ledger_account"."name_en" IS NOT NULL OR "ledger_account"."name_bn" IS NOT NULL

voucher_decision_complete.name: voucher_decision_complete
voucher_decision_complete.value: ("voucher"."status" = 'pending') = ("voucher"."decided_by" IS NULL) AND ("voucher"."decided_by" IS NULL) = ("voucher"."decided_at" IS NULL)

member_has_name.name: member_has_name
member_has_name.value: "member"."name_en" IS NOT NULL OR "member"."name_bn" IS NOT NULL

member_nid_complete.name: member_nid_complete
member_nid_complete.value: ("member"."nid_cipher" IS NULL) = ("member"."nid_hash" IS NULL) AND ("member"."nid_cipher" IS NULL) = ("member"."nid_last4" IS NULL)

nominee_has_name.name: nominee_has_name
nominee_has_name.value: "nominee"."name_en" IS NOT NULL OR "nominee"."name_bn" IS NOT NULL

nominee_nid_complete.name: nominee_nid_complete
nominee_nid_complete.value: ("nominee"."nid_cipher" IS NULL) = ("nominee"."nid_hash" IS NULL) AND ("nominee"."nid_cipher" IS NULL) = ("nominee"."nid_last4" IS NULL)

savings_withdrawal_decision_complete.name: savings_withdrawal_decision_complete
savings_withdrawal_decision_complete.value: ("savings_withdrawal"."status" = 'pending') = ("savings_withdrawal"."decided_by" IS NULL) AND ("savings_withdrawal"."decided_by" IS NULL) = ("savings_withdrawal"."decided_at" IS NULL)

loan_decided.name: loan_decided
loan_decided.value: ("loan"."status" = 'applied') = ("loan"."decided_by" IS NULL) AND ("loan"."decided_by" IS NULL) = ("loan"."decided_at" IS NULL)

loan_disbursed.name: loan_disbursed
loan_disbursed.value:
("loan"."status" IN ('disbursed', 'closed')) = ("loan"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("loan"."entry_id" IS NULL) = ("loan"."disbursed_on" IS NULL)
          AND ("loan"."entry_id" IS NULL) = ("loan"."disbursed_by" IS NULL)
          AND ("loan"."entry_id" IS NULL) = ("loan"."payment_method" IS NULL)

member_exit_decision_complete.name: member_exit_decision_complete
member_exit_decision_complete.value: ("member_exit"."status" = 'pending') = ("member_exit"."decided_by" IS NULL) AND ("member_exit"."decided_by" IS NULL) = ("member_exit"."decided_at" IS NULL)

member_exit_approved_amounts.name: member_exit_approved_amounts
member_exit_approved_amounts.value: ("member_exit"."status" = 'approved') = ("member_exit"."share_refund" IS NOT NULL) AND ("member_exit"."share_refund" IS NULL) = ("member_exit"."savings_payout" IS NULL)
